import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,os,re,hashlib
ids=json.load(open('reservation.json'))['ids']
srcs=['2001.03916','1912.05775','1208.5670','2512.09186','2206.00400','2009.01074','1805.05483','1610.09210','1503.02380','1406.7872','1408.1940','1408.2935','0702371','2506.14219','2409.10129','2002.04579','1507.04169','2602.11773','2411.18782','2011.14142']
allow=json.load(open('historical-results-allowlist.json'))
print('allow entries',len(allow))
prot=re.compile(r'(hat|formal|code-loop|codeloop|polynexus|crown|bunkbed|tournament|r395|r463|r466|r482|expanded-corpus-r531|expanded-corpus-r395|expanded-corpus-r463|expanded-corpus-r466|expanded-corpus-r482)',re.I)
base='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/'
checked=0;skipped=0;hits={}
idre=re.compile(r'(?<![\d.])('+'|'.join(map(str,ids))+r')(?![\d.])')
srcre=re.compile('|'.join(re.escape(s) for s in srcs))
access=[]
for p,h in allow.items():
    rel=os.path.relpath(p,base)
    if any(prot.search(x) for x in rel.split(os.sep)):
        skipped+=1; continue
    checked+=1
    access.append(p)
    try:
        s=open(p,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    except Exception as e:
        print('ERR',p,e); continue
    a=set(idre.findall(s)); b=set(srcre.findall(s))
    if a or b:
        hits[rel]=dict(ids=sorted(a),srcs=sorted(b),n=len(s))
print('checked',checked,'skipped',skipped,'hits',len(hits))
for k,v in hits.items(): print(k,v)
